# Demo URLs

<!-- Generated by `npm run demo:urls` — do not edit by hand. -->

Base: `http://localhost:3000` (override with `BASE=https://... npm run demo:urls`).
**live** marks an embed running on the production site — treat its code paths as production-facing.

## Modes

| URL | Embed | Concept engine | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `http://localhost:3000/` | no | no | Default app — sidebar, KB panel, sessions |
| `http://localhost:3000/?mode=clover` **live** | yes | no | Chat-only embed |
| `http://localhost:3000/?mode=business-owner` **live** | yes | no | Chat-only embed |
| `http://localhost:3000/?mode=iso` | yes | no | Chat-only embed |
| `http://localhost:3000/?mode=concept-embed` | yes | yes | Panel demo, embeddable |
| `http://localhost:3000/?mode=vw` **live** | yes | no | Chat-only embed |
| `http://localhost:3000/?mode=concept` | no | yes | Panel demo with the welcome card catalog |
| `http://localhost:3000/?mode=concept-nav` | no | yes | Alias of `concept` — the hover-rail sidebar it trialled is now app-wide; kept so shared links keep working |
| `http://localhost:3000/?mode=tib` | no | no | Full app (sidebar, sessions, KB panel) wearing the TIB brand |
| `http://localhost:3000/?mode=woodforest` | no | no | Full app (sidebar, sessions, KB panel) wearing the Woodforest brand |

Any other `?mode=` value falls through to the default app.

## Flows with no embed URL

7 of 21 flows have no slug — reachable only via the `?mode=concept` welcome cards.

- 1. Simple Update — Chat only
- 3. Panel as Form — Chat + form
- 4. Step-up Auth — Multi-step
- 7. Case Management — ISO · Multi-panel
- 8. Bulk Action — Bulk · Multi-panel
- 10. Risk Investigation — Risk · Multi-panel
- 11. Work Queue — ISO · Queue

## Other routes

- `http://localhost:3000/risk` — Aperia Risk shell. `?alerted=` / `?worked=` are read by `QueueSummaryCard`.

## Embedded in production

Deployed at `https://aperia-ask-nanci-embed.vercel.app`. Anything below is production-facing — verify changes to its code
path in a browser, not just `next build`.

**This list is hand-maintained and incomplete by nature.** It records embeds that have been
found, not every embed that exists: `../webflow` is a one-commit snapshot that can lag the
published Webflow site, and a page in neither repo would not show up here. For the complete
picture use Vercel referrer data for the `aperia-ask-nanci-embed` project (Web Analytics →
Referrers, or the `Referer` header in runtime logs).
